name: New Administrative Capital, study box
label: ASSUMPTION
note: OpenStreetMap holds no boundary for the capital (feasibility test T-B1-003), and no OSM-derived geometry is stored in git (decision G2). This file holds only an anchor point from Wikidata (CC0), a search half-width, a margin and the names of masterplan landmarks. At fetch time the landmarks are searched within the half-width of the anchor, and the study box is their bounding box plus the margin; that box is stored only in the git-ignored cache. The landmark names are spelled as their name:en tags in OpenStreetMap so that the query matches them; no position is stored. The box is an approximation: it may take in ground next to the capital and leave out parts of the masterplan that no landmark marks.

anchor.source: Wikidata Q19588497 (The New Capital), property P625, CC0; read 2026-10-26, entity modified 2026-10-10
